WithholdingTax.name: Withholding Tax
WithholdingTax.definition: Percentage of a cash distribution that will be withheld by a tax authority.

WithholdingOfForeignTax.name: Withholding Of Foreign Tax
WithholdingOfForeignTax.definition: Rate at which the income will be withheld by the jurisdiction in which the income was originally paid, for which relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

WithholdingOfLocalTax.name: Withholding Of Local Tax
WithholdingOfLocalTax.definition: Rate at which the income will be withheld by the jurisdiction in which the account owner is located, for which relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

GermanLocalTax1.name: German Local Tax 1
GermanLocalTax1.definition: Local tax (ZAS Anrechnungsbetrag) subject to interest down payment tax (proportion of interest liable for interest down payment tax/interim profit that is not covered by the tax exempt amount).

GermanLocalTax2.name: German Local Tax 2
GermanLocalTax2.definition: Local tax (ZAS Pflichtige Zinsen) interest liable for interest down payment tax (proportion of gross interest per unit/interim profits that is not covered by the credit in the interest pool).

GermanLocalTax3.name: German Local Tax 3
GermanLocalTax3.definition: Local tax (Zinstopf) offset interest per unit against tax exempt amount (variation to offset interest per unit in relation to tax exempt amount).

GermanLocalTax4.name: German Local Tax 4
GermanLocalTax4.definition: Local tax (Ertrag Besitzanteilig) yield liable for interest down payment tax.

TaxOnIncome.name: Tax On Income
TaxOnIncome.definition: Taxation applied on an amount clearly identified as an income.

TaxOnProfit.name: Tax On Profit
TaxOnProfit.definition: Taxation applied on an amount clearly identified as capital profits, capital gains.

TaxReclaim.name: Tax Reclaim
TaxReclaim.definition: Percentage of cash that was paid in excess of actual tax obligation and was reclaimed.

FiscalStamp.name: Fiscal Stamp
FiscalStamp.definition: Percentage of fiscal tax to apply.

Proration.name: Proration
Proration.definition: Proportionate allocation used for the offer.

NewToOld.name: New To Old
NewToOld.definition: Quantity of new securities for a given quantity of underlying securities, where the underlying securities will be exchanged or debited, eg, 2 for 1: 2 new equities credited for every 1 underlying equity debited = 2 resulting equities.

NewSecuritiesToUnderlyingSecurities.name: New Securities To Underlying Securities
NewSecuritiesToUnderlyingSecurities.definition: Quantity of new equities that will be derived by the exercise of a given quantity of intermediate securities.

AdditionalQuantityForExistingSecurities.name: Additional Quantity For Existing Securities
AdditionalQuantityForExistingSecurities.definition: Quantity of additional securities for a given quantity of underlying securities where underlying securities are not exchanged or debited, eg, 1 for 1: 1 new|equity credited for every 1 underlying equity = 2 resulting equities.

AdditionalQuantityForSubscribedResultant.name: Additional Quantity For Subscribed Resultant Securities
AdditionalQuantityForSubscribedResultant.definition: Quantity of additional intermediate securities/new equities awarded for a given quantity of securities derived from subscription.

RelatedTax.name: Related Tax
RelatedTax.definition: Percentage of the gross dividend rate on which tax must be paid.

NonResidentRate.name: Non Resident Rate
NonResidentRate.definition: Rate per share to which a non-resident is entitled.

Charges.name: Charges
Charges.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of the charges/fees that cannot be categorised.

InterestForUsedPayment.name: Interest For Used Payment
InterestForUsedPayment.definition: The actual interest rate used for the payment of the interest for the specified interest period.

IndexFactor.name: Index Factor
IndexFactor.definition: Public index rate applied to the amount paid to adjust it to inflation.

FullyFranked.name: Fully Franked
FullyFranked.definition: Rate resulting from a fully franked dividend paid by a company; rate includes tax credit for companies that have made sufficient tax payments during fiscal period.

GrossDividend.name: Gross Dividend
GrossDividend.definition: Cash dividend amount per equity before deductions or allowances have been made.

NetDividend.name: Net Dividend
NetDividend.definition: Cash dividend amount per equity after deductions or allowances have been made.

CashIncentive.name: Cash Incentive
CashIncentive.definition: Rate of the cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event, e.g. consent fees.

SolicitationFee.name: Solicitation Fee
SolicitationFee.definition: Cash rate made available in an offer in order to encourage participation in the offer.

MaximumAllowedOversubscription.name: Maximum Allowed Oversubscription
MaximumAllowedOversubscription.definition: A maximum percentage of shares available through the over subscription privilege, usually a percentage of the basic subscription shares, eg, an account owner subscribing to 100 shares may over subscribe to a maximum of 50 additional shares when the over subscription maximum is 50%.

AdditionalTax.name: Additional Tax
AdditionalTax.definition: Rate used for additional tax that cannot be categorised.

OriginalAmount.name: Original Amount
OriginalAmount.definition: Amount in its original currency when conversion from/into another currency has occurred.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Provides information about a foreign exchange.

ApplicableRate.name: Applicable Rate
ApplicableRate.definition: Rate applicable to the event announced, eg, redemption rate for a redemption event.
